description: This Java class `BaseClientData` serves as an immutable data container for maintain the state related to a client's connection, including IDs, status, details, time since current status, and session sender info. It provides getter methods, state update methods returning new instances, and overrides for `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString`. It is used within the context of a messaging or connection management component of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: BaseClientData
classes.description: An immutable class encapsulating the client's connection state, including IDs, status, session sender info, and timestamp details.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the connection.

methods.name: getConnectionStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing details about the current connection status.

methods.name: getInConnectionStatusSince
methods.description: Returns the Instant since when the connection has been in its current status.

methods.name: getSessionSenders
methods.description: Returns the list of session sender ActorRef and DittoHeaders pairs.

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided Connection object.

methods.name: setConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the updated connection status.

methods.name: setDesiredConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the updated desired connection status.

methods.name: setConnectionStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified connection status details.

methods.name: addSessionSender
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the added session sender and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets session info, clearing session sender list, returning a new instance.
